occurrences.englishText: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”
Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer* “Beer” is Hebrew for “well”, i.e., a village named for its well. and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
